description: A quarter turn of a unit circle whose nearest point misses the y axis by 9.9e-8, in either direction. The cap meridians share a single horn pole. Pappus gives pi*pi/2 for the volume, pi*pi for the wall area and 2*pi for the two disk caps.

analytic.counts_differ: Arris seats a circle within model tolerance of tangency on the axis, collapsing the tiny edge and its two endpoints to one shared pole. Open CASCADE keeps that edge and both vertices.
